role: area storm with a 0.75 s tell (Petal Storm, moving Petal Tornado)
style: stylized anime combat, glowing additive sakura (Senbonzakura) over a dark night arena, side-view 2D

beats.name: tell
beats.expect: pink floor ellipse, petals sliding inward

beats.name: release
beats.expect: white release flash and floor ring

beats.name: storm
beats.expect: petals spiral up in a helix, wrapped in torn strands

layer_plan.name: 0:Floor tell
layer_plan.role: anticipation: pink ellipse on the floor where it will rise

layer_plan.name: 1:Gathering petals
layer_plan.role: anticipation: petals sliding inward over the floor

layer_plan.name: 4:Spiral pivot
layer_plan.role: pivot yawing the stream so rising petals trace a helix

layer_plan.name: 4:Spiral pivot/1:Spiral strands
layer_plan.role: shape change: torn strands wrapping the column

layer_plan.name: 6:Thrown petals
layer_plan.role: matter: pale petals thrown off the storm

acceptance: The floor tell is readable from f10 to f45 (the dodge window)
Rising petals trace a helix, not a straight column
The storm cuts off cleanly enough that its end is visible
avoid: A tell so bright it reads as the storm already hitting
